mapper.select:
SELECT rd.line_id AS "lineId", rd.id AS "directionId", boarding.stop_id AS "boardingStopId", boarding.stop_sequence AS "boardingSequence",
alighting.stop_id AS "alightingStopId", alighting.stop_sequence AS "alightingSequence"
CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS "alightingStopId", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "alightingSequence"
FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop boarding ON boarding.direction_id = rd.id AND boarding.line_id = rd.line_id
INNER JOIN directed_stop alighting ON alighting.direction_id = rd.id AND alighting.line_id = rd.line_id AND alighting.stop_id = #{alightingStopId} AND alighting.stop_sequence > boarding.stop_sequence
WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND rd.id = #{directionId} AND rd.active = TRUE AND boarding.stop_id = #{boardingStopId}
